# System role catalog

<!-- MACHINE GENERATED: DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE DIRECTLY. -->

These roles are installed from `api/config/bootstrap/rbac/roles.seed.ndjson`.
This reference is generated by `scripts/docs/export_permissions_reference.py`.

Installed roles are protected definitions. Assign them to accounts or create center-owned
roles for a different combination of permissions. Assay/environment access scopes still
apply; a permission grant does not by itself grant access to every clinical sample.
The `superuser` role bypasses normal access policies and is reserved for emergency access.

Query-rule and reporting-rule workflows have separate grants. Assign independent people
to authoring and review; granting both roles does not waive the independence checks.

| Role ID | Label | Responsibility | Grants |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`admin`](#admin) | Clinical administrator | Manages assays, assay configurations, gene lists, clinical reporting rules and catalog governance. Does not manage accounts or system controls. | 70 |
| [`app_control_operator`](#app-control-operator) | Application Control Operator | Views and changes runtime controls and can run approved maintenance. | 4 |
| [`asp_manager`](#asp-manager) | ASP Manager | Creates and manages assay panel definitions. | 5 |
| [`aspc_manager`](#aspc-manager) | ASPC Manager | Creates and manages environment-specific assay configurations and filters. | 5 |
| [`catalog_author`](#catalog-author) | Catalog author | Public assay catalog author. | 3 |
| [`catalog_publisher`](#catalog-publisher) | Catalog publisher | Public assay catalog publisher. | 2 |
| [`catalog_reviewer`](#catalog-reviewer) | Catalog reviewer | Public assay catalog reviewer. | 2 |
| [`catalog_viewer`](#catalog-viewer) | Catalog viewer | Public assay catalog viewer. | 1 |
| [`clinical_rule_author`](#clinical-rule-author) | Clinical Rule Author | Creates, validates, previews, and submits clinical reporting rule drafts. | 4 |
| [`clinical_rule_publisher`](#clinical-rule-publisher) | Clinical Rule Publisher | Publishes independently approved clinical rule releases and retires active releases. | 3 |
| [`clinical_rule_reviewer`](#clinical-rule-reviewer) | Clinical Rule Reviewer | Performs independent clinical review of submitted reporting rules. | 3 |
| [`clinical_rule_tester`](#clinical-rule-tester) | Clinical Rule Tester | Runs read-only rule-set validation and sample-backed report previews without authoring, reviewing, publishing, or retiring clinical content. | 2 |
| [`clinical_rule_viewer`](#clinical-rule-viewer) | Clinical Rule Viewer | Reads governed clinical reporting rule sets, their release history, provenance, and exported canonical JSON without changing clinical content. | 1 |
| [`developer`](#developer) | Developer | Full access to configurations and testing features, no user management. | 54 |
| [`external`](#external) | External | Restricted read-only access, typically used for external collaborators. | 5 |
| [`intern`](#intern) | Intern | Intern with limited analysis specific access | 24 |
| [`isgl_manager`](#isgl-manager) | ISGL Manager | Creates and manages in-silico gene lists. | 5 |
| [`manager`](#manager) | Manager | Can manage samples and configs within assigned groups. Cannot modify app-level or user-wide settings. | 44 |
| [`monitoring_group`](#monitoring-group) | System error monitoring | Receives system error emails and attached service logs. Grants no application permissions. | 0 |
| [`operations_viewer`](#operations-viewer) | Operations Viewer | Read-only access to operational state, audit events, and administrative diagnostics. | 5 |
| [`query_rule_author`](#query-rule-author) | Query Rule Author | Creates and modifies query-rule drafts without approving or publishing them. | 2 |
| [`query_rule_publisher`](#query-rule-publisher) | Query Rule Publisher | Publishes approved query-rule versions and retires publications to restore inheritance. | 3 |
| [`query_rule_reviewer`](#query-rule-reviewer) | Query Rule Reviewer | Independently approves saved query-rule drafts without editing or publishing them. | 2 |
| [`query_rule_tester`](#query-rule-tester) | Query Rule Tester | Tests query policies against samples within assigned assay and environment scopes without editing or publishing rules. | 2 |
| [`query_rule_viewer`](#query-rule-viewer) | Query Rule Viewer | Inspects query-rule versions and previews effective inherited policies. | 1 |
| [`superuser`](#superuser) | Superuser | Emergency platform access for initial setup and controlled recovery, not routine administration. | 100 |
| [`sys_admin`](#sys-admin) | System administrator | Manages accounts, access assignments, application controls and operational health. Clinical access requires separate roles. | 37 |
| [`tester`](#tester) | Tester | Can test full features except user, schema, or config-level access. | 46 |
| [`user`](#user) | Standard User | Can view and interact with samples assigned to their group. No admin or config access. | 35 |
| [`user_account_manager`](#user-account-manager) | User Account Manager | Creates and manages user accounts and their role and scope assignments while passwords remain in dedicated security flows. | 11 |
| [`viewer`](#viewer) | Viewer | Read-only access to samples and reports. | 15 |
